title: Canada
description: Canada combines forest tracks, lakesides and mountain terrain, with cabins and viewpoints to discover between driving objectives.

sections.heading: The Valhallas
paragraphs: Canada has three release areas: Emerald Lake, Gimli Ridge and Asgard Mountain. Lakeside tracks give way to steeper routes, cabins and challenge trails in the mountains.

sections.heading: Vehicle rewards
paragraphs: Hermit Trail rewards the Burro and Windy Joe Trail rewards the Trail Burner in Emerald Lake. Further Canadian challenge rewards include the Brick, Bull, Polyana, Blast Wagon, Grand Woodman, Timberbox and Mammoth.

seo.title: Canada | Over the Hill Wiki
seo.description: Forests, lakeside tracks and mountain routes. Explore the Canadian wilderness one cabin, viewpoint and trail at a time.

evidenceNote: Release area names and named locations checked against independent release map records; game map textures retain their original appearance.
playerNotes: Explore lakeside routes, forests and mountain terrain. Cabins and portals give you reasons to revisit the map as the trip opens up.

title: Algeria
description: Algeria’s desert landscapes include dunes, rocky corridors, canyon ledges and natural arches.

sections.heading: Across Algeria
paragraphs: Tassili n’Ajjer Desert and Aurès Mountains make up the Algerian release areas. The map lists camps, scenic points, challenge trails and desert wildlife photography targets.

sections.heading: Desert challenge rewards
paragraphs: El Kalaa North Ascent rewards the Wombat; El Kalaa South Ascent rewards the Woodman. Tarfa Ascent rewards the Boar, while Shabah Ascent rewards the Marshal.

seo.title: Algeria | Over the Hill Wiki
seo.description: Dunes, canyon ledges and dramatic rock formations. Pack for gaps and recovery before heading into the desert.

facts.label: Equipment footage
facts.value: Plank supports at a rocky ledge

playerNotes: Take the trip into dunes, rocky corridors and canyon crossings. Bring planks and recovery equipment when planning around gaps and ledges.

title: Emerald Lake
description: A lakeside Canadian area with six cabins, two watchtower viewpoints and three challenge trails. Windy Joe and Hermit Trail connect exploration to vehicle unlocks.

playerNotes: Cabins and camps: Pavilion Lake Cabin, Birch Grove Hut, Elizabeth Lake Cabin, Brew Hut, Black Bear's Den, Malachite Lodge.
